why_rejected: Actual rotary prompt placement plus exact full-current-query cold ranking already failed its registered 30-row development advancement CI gate. A bounded page approximation with the same quota is not a new established quality mechanism; do not rerun that failed combination as a larger 135-row trial under a new name.

An exact selector optimizes one-step attention-mass objective, not downstream task quality. A page approximation could change trajectories and theoretically regularize them; this possibility alone supplies no justified quality hypothesis or superiority proof.
Previous native fixed8-page centroid recall screen failed; exact current-query pathway and source already exist, so this is not a missing implementation opportunity.

Historical box-bound offline screen also gives poor small-budget recall; valid coordinatewise bounds can be extremely loose. CPU counterexample preserves valid bounds while entirely excluding the truly best page.

An upper bound on per-head raw q dot k is not an upper bound on mean-head normalized probability objective used by current selector. Top-page selection is heuristic unless its stopping rule bounds that actual objective.
